identity: Tilburg University, Culture and Education track of the degree family Digital Culture and Society (registered as Algemene Cultuurwetenschappen, 56823), September 2026 intake, Dutch and English. The separate English Digital Culture and Society curriculum provides family evidence for a candidate only.

Students choosing Culture complete a placement at a cultural organisation, such as a museum, library or heritage institution.
The third year begins with 30 EC of elective study. Tilburg lists a minor, exchange or study abroad.
The regulations specify 120 completed EC and named methods courses. Confirm the applicable methods requirements for the Culture and Education track.
sourceFindings: The Tilburg programme page lists Culture before Education. The adopted English Appendix 1 Article 2.7, pp. 52–54, and Dutch Appendix 1, pp. 58–59, confirm the cohort, ten shared six-credit first-year courses and eight shared six-credit second-year courses. The formal year-two title for course 800855-B-6 is Education: Between Opportunity and Inequality, while the public page calls it Onderwijs in de 21ste eeuw. Culture/Heritage Profession adds the 12 EC internship 800710-B-12 in spring of year two. Education/Teacher instead adds two six-credit language and literacy units. GROW appears each year with zero credits.

The official target page describes a cultural-institution placement, with museum, library and heritage organisations as examples. The appendix places the internship after 90 scheduled EC. General OER Article 4.5 refers participation to the applicable internship regulations and course catalogue. A cohort-applicable entry rule for 800710-B-12 was not established.

Article 2.7 places the 30 EC elective semester in autumn of year three. By spring the ordinary sequence can accumulate 150 EC, satisfying the published 120 EC thesis credit threshold. The public page and English appendix list Language and Diversity at 6 EC; the Dutch appendix prints 12 EC, making the individual spring credits sum to 36 despite its 30 EC heading. The public page lists Sociology of Education at 6 EC, while both formal appendices list Educational Science 890902-B-6. Truth and Fiction and the 12 EC thesis are present across sources.

Article 2.5(d) of both appendices requires three named methods units for the thesis after completing 120 EC. Doing Research: Methodology and Doing Research: Ethnography and Discourse Analysis are in the track’s first year. Doing Research: Digital Data and Digital Techniques (800177-B-6) appears in the separate English track, not in the Culture and Education schedule. No track-specific waiver or equivalent was identified. The 30 EC elective window cannot be treated as a verified route through an unverified requirement.

The target page and regulations support Dutch and English instruction, with the target page describing primarily Dutch instruction in years two and three. The English degree-family page supports media, digital inquiry and AI in society. It does not establish the exact target’s year-three rules.
